channel.title: Dr. Raychel Powers, writing
channel.description: Essays and guides from licensed psychologist Dr. Raychel Powers.

item.title: Listen to your partner even when you don't want to
item.description: Twenty minutes of bickering and nobody feels heard. Here is what to do differently in the middle of the argument, and it starts with listening.

item.title: Metta in the Wild: The Secret Kindness Game
item.description: A gentle, mischievous, grounded practice you can play anywhere. Find three players, secretly send them a bloom of kindness, and feel your own nervous system settle.

item.title: Understanding Polyamory and Solo Poly: A Journey of Love Without Limits
item.description: What polyamory is, what makes solo poly different, and why loving yourself first is the foundation of loving without limits.

item.title: How Nature Shapes the Brain: The Neuroscience of Greenery, Mountains, and Plants
item.description: Forests, mountain views, even a houseplant on your desk change how your brain works. A tour of the research on attention, stress, rumination, memory, and creativity.

item.title: Power of Sleep Protocol
item.description: For resetting dopamine, restoring mental energy, and sleeping like a monk. Eight habits plus the ultimate before-bed routine, minute by minute.

item.title: How to Meditate
item.description: A simple, ten-step starting guide to meditation, from finding a quiet space to building a regular practice, with kindness toward the wandering mind.

item.title: Remote Learning and Student Mental Health: An Interview
item.description: My answers to a Florida State University student's questions on how remote learning affects attention, anxiety, and motivation, and what students and professors can do about it.
